name: Jawline and chin definition
summary: Definition through the jawline often softens gradually over time, and is one of the more visible changes people first notice in their own photographs.
imageAlt: Skin with a pale line, close-up
statement: Definition through the jawline often *softens gradually over time*, and is one of the more visible changes people first notice in their own photographs.
happening: Definition through the jawline and chin depends on the balance between bone structure, soft tissue and skin tension. As support beneath the skin shifts and gravity has a longer effect, the line that once separated face from neck softens. This is usually a gradual change, and is often first noticed in photographs rather than the mirror.

factors.title: Gradual structural change
factors.text: A softer jawline typically develops gradually beneath the surface, which is why it is often noticed later than it began.

factors.title: Individual rate of change
factors.text: The pace at which a softer jawline progresses varies between patients, shaped by genetics, lifestyle and skin type.

factors.title: Compounding factors
factors.text: A softer jawline rarely occurs in isolation, and is usually assessed alongside related structural changes nearby.

recommendedText: Considered where jawline definition has softened due to volume change, to restore contour without altering the face's overall proportions.
alongsideText: Often assessed alongside, since these concerns frequently share the same treatment options.

steps.title: Assessment first
steps.text: We look at the jawline, chin and neck together, since the line between face and neck depends on all three.

steps.title: Volume or laxity
steps.text: We confirm whether the softening comes mainly from a change in volume or from laxity, since each points to a different treatment.

steps.title: A measured approach
steps.text: Contour is restored gradually, so the face keeps its own proportions.

steps.title: Ongoing review
steps.text: Definition keeps changing with time, so the plan is reviewed at follow-up and adjusted as needed.
